findings.detail: The source-supported quarterly investment-income yield is about 2.73%, so the F27 failure is attributable to the weak holdings-WAC comparison rather than the fund-financials value.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation supports the extracted income yield: the filing reports three-month total investment income of $31,542,755 (table 7 row 14) and total investments at fair value of $1,153,413,327 (table 38 row 9), implying 2.7347%, close to the flagged 2.7569%. The raw schedule also presents loan interest rates as annual percentages, while the tested income yield is a three-month measure. The source therefore supports the financial data and does not support treating the weak WAC heuristic failure as a data defect. Residual risk is that the bundle does not expose the check's exact computed WAC scalar, so the precise anchor-construction defect is not localized.
